Nadcházející termín i s informacemi, co: Your upcoming appointment, with information on what to bring. Book a new examination, running analysis or video consultation here.
Nemusíte čekat měsíc na další termín. Pl: You don't have to wait a month for the next appointment. The plan is adjusted as soon as something changes.
Nemusíte hádat, jestli dnes přidat, nebo: You don't have to guess whether to add or cut back today. The recommendation is recalculated every morning from the new data.
Nové běhy z hodinek čekají na krátký záp: New runs from your watch wait for a short entry: how the run went, how your legs felt and whether anything hurt. It takes about twenty seconds.
Pět kanálů zátěže: objem, intenzita, kle: Five load channels: volume, intensity, descent, ascent and total load. For each you see how much of the weekly capacity you've used and how much you can still afford today.
Po špatné noci unesete méně. Došlap podl: After a bad night you can take less. Došlap lowers today's ceilings accordingly in the morning.
Pod běhy k zápisu otevřete přehled ohodn: Below the runs to log you'll find an overview of rated runs with your feeling and note. Tap to edit an entry; the icon on the right opens the run detail with terrain, weather and segments.
Pod souhrnem check-inů otevřete všechny: Below the check-in summary you'll find all daily check-ins and weekly questionnaires, with pain, stiffness and fatigue.
Postupné zvyšování s pravidelným odlehče: Gradual increases with regular easier weeks are a proven training principle. Došlap keeps to it for you.
Před závodem s prioritou A se trénink sá: Before an A-priority race, training calms down by itself so that you arrive at the start rested.
Připravenost po dnech. Pod grafem otevře: Readiness by day. Below the chart you can open sleep, HRV and resting heart rate from your watch, always against your own norm.
Program s cviky na míru, Fyzioterapeut p: A tailored exercise Programme, Physiotherapist for messages and appointments, and Injury for reporting problems and check-up conclusions.
Prudký nárůst objemu je podle výzkumu sp: According to research, a sharp increase in volume is linked to more frequent running problems (Nielsen et al., 2014). Here you see it straight away.
Průměrný pocit z běhů a jeho trend, poče: The average feeling from your runs and its trend, the number of entries in 21 days, how often something hurt and the highest pain reported.
rok narození, pohlaví, zranění, cílový z: year of birth, sex, injuries, goal race
Rozlišíte jednorázový výkyv po náročném: You can tell a one-off swing after a hard run from a creeping trend.
Signály seřazené podle toho, o kolik pro: Signals sorted by how many percentage points they take off the overall Score, for example descent over capacity or longer ground contact. Tap to see which activities or records contribute to the signal.
Skóre driftu po dnech za posledních 6 mě: Drift score by day over the last 6 months. Values above the threshold of 25 mean your technique is staying outside your norm.
Skóre není černá skříňka. Vidíte, co pře: The score isn't a black box. You see exactly what makes it up and know what to focus on.
Skóre zátěže po dnech za posledních 6 mě: Load score by day over the last 6 months. Above the threshold of 25 the load is raised.
Souhrn poslední prohlídky, který fyziote: A summary of the last check-up, checked and approved by the physiotherapist, with the findings and recommendations.
Souhrnný signál vaší běžecké techniky. P: An overall signal of your running technique. It's always compared with comparable runs at the same pace and terrain, never with other people's average.
Srovnání metrik na rovině, do kopce, z k: A comparison of the metrics on the flat, uphill, downhill and at different paces.
Teď už víte, kde co najdete. Průvodce se: Now you know where to find everything. The guide returns to your own data and you can run it again any time via the profile icon → Getting started.
Teď už víte, kde co najdete. Ukázku může: Now you know where to find everything. You can keep browsing the demo freely, or create an account and connect your own watch data.
Tělo nezatěžují jen kilometry. Seběh z k: It isn't only kilometres that load the body. Running downhill acts differently from the flat, so it's counted separately.
Tlačítko Check-in otevře krátký dotazník: The Check-in button opens a short questionnaire on pain, stiffness and fatigue. You mark pain right on the body map and the whole thing takes a few seconds.
Trénink běží ve čtyřtýdenních cyklech, t: Training runs in four-week cycles, three building weeks and one easier week. The bars show the volume of recent weeks and the target for the current one; you can adjust your position in the cycle.
Týdenní součet objemu, intenzity, klesán: The weekly sum of volume, intensity, descent, ascent and total load against your capacity, plus strength load for strength training. The demo shows descent raised by a steep trail run.
Ukážeme vám aplikaci na ukázkovém běžci: We'll show you the app on a demo runner with made-up data, without signing up. We'll go through six tabs and at most five features on each. For each you'll see what it shows and why it helps you. Use the arrows to move forward or back, and you can end the demo at any time.
Ukážeme vám aplikaci na ukázkovém účtu s: We'll show you the app on a demo account with your name. We'll go through six tabs and at most five features on each. For each you'll see what it shows and why it helps you. Use the arrows to move forward or back.

Uvidíte, jak rychle se po náročných týdn: You'll see how fast you get back to your norm after hard weeks.
V kopci běžíte jinak než na rovině. Poro: You run differently uphill than on the flat. Comparing like with like filters out false alarms.
Velké číslo je celkové skóre dne od 0 do: The big number is the day's overall score from 0 to 100 — the higher, the better. Tap it (the arrow by Score) to open how your state developed over 6 months. Around it are four rings: readiness, symptoms, load and mechanics; tap any of them to open its detail.
Vertikální poměr, kontakt se zemí, kaden: Vertical ratio, ground contact, cadence, balance and more. Each metric is labelled within the norm, on the edge or outside the norm, and a tap opens its trend.
Vidíte svůj progres a fyzioterapeut ví,: You see your progress, and your physiotherapist knows whether the programme works without having to ask.
Víte nejen, co běžet, ale i kde je dnes: You know not only what to run but also where today's ceiling is. Pace and heart rate are calculated from your own runs.
Víte přesně, která část kroku se mění, a: You know exactly which part of your stride is changing — and that's what a physiotherapist can work with.
Všechno kolem péče o tělo je na jednom m: Everything around body care is in one place and follows on from your data.
Všechny běhy s metrikami techniky. Každý: All runs with technique metrics. Each can be opened, compared with a run from a month ago or excluded from the calculations, for example when the watch measured nonsense.
Vývoj za několik týdnů ukáže trend, kter: Several weeks show a trend you can't see in a single day. Your physiotherapist will see the connections in it.
Za pár vteřin víte, jak na tom tělo dnes: In a few seconds you know how your body is doing today, and you immediately see which area is pulling the score down.
Žádné telefonování ani e-maily. Fyzioter: No phone calls or e-mails. Your physiotherapist has the context before the appointment.
Zátěž a mechanika společně určí jeden ze: Load and mechanics together decide one of four states: stable, overload, silent drift or critical combination. Tap to see how your state developed over the last 6 months.
Změna techniky bývá časným znakem únavy,: A change in technique is often an early sign of fatigue, often before you feel it at all.
